## DIARRHEA WITH CAMPYLOBACTER
## Primary treatment
Hydration and electrolyte replacement
## Antimicrobial treatment for those with severe disease or risk of severe disease
Fluoroquinolone resistance is increasing worldwide. Macrolide resistance is
rare.
## Inpatient

Primary:
[Azithromycin 1000 mg PO one-time dose [M]](psjzid-azithromycin-1gm-po-once)
< OR >
[Azithromycin 500 mg PO q24h for 3 days [M]](psjzid-azithromycin-500mg-po-q24h)
Alternative:
[Ciprofloxacin 500 mg PO q12h for 5 days [R,DI]](psjzid-ciprofloxacin-500mg-po-q12h)
